subject.title: macOS launchd Gateway still restarts via gateway-update/update.run; document and honor auto-update kill-switch

question: Should `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` also block supervised Gateway `update.run` managed handoffs, or should it remain scoped to configured background auto-update applies?
rationale: The code change is small, but the behavior is a product contract decision because it changes whether an explicit control-plane update request is allowed to restart a supervised Gateway.

options.title: Keep env scoped, clarify explicit updates
options.body: Keep `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE` limited to automatic applies, make the docs and diagnostics unmistakable, and resolve launchd `update.run` reliability under the broader tracker.

options.title: Extend existing kill-switch
options.body: Gate supervised Gateway `update.run` before managed handoff creation when the env var is truthy, then update tests and docs for the broadened contract.

options.title: Add a separate control-plane pause
options.body: Introduce a distinct operator policy for control-plane update requests so background auto-update suppression and explicit update refusal remain separate concepts.

recommendation.title: Keep env scoped, clarify explicit updates
recommendation.body: Keep `OPENCLAW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE` limited to automatic applies, make the docs and diagnostics unmistakable, and resolve launchd `update.run` reliability under the broader tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent introduced the current kill-switch and has recent nearby updater service-state history, making him the clearest routing owner for the scope decision.
